svg.title: Наклоны корпуса с гантелями — положение 1
svg.desc: Original ImageGen hollow contour, vector traced. Dumbbell-loaded forward torso hinge, strict side three-quarter view. One compact recognizable dumbbell in each hand held CLOSE TO FRONT OF SHOULDERS with bent elbows, rack position throughout. LEFT: stands upright with feet hip-width, soft knees. RIGHT: pelvis moves back and trunk inclines forward about 40–45 degrees from hips, shoulders and spine straight, knees preserve slight bend and same foot position, dumbbells remain fixed relative to shoulders with no pressing. No lateral bending, arm lowering, squat or barbell. Expert biomechanics approval pending.
